# tg-search-engine · Telegram Search Engine

> LLM / AI-search summary for https://github.com/tytsxai/tg-search-engine

Self-hosted **Telegram channel crawler + full-text search engine**. **Telethon** crawls historical and realtime messages; a pipeline filters/transforms text (Chinese jieba, pinyin, OpenCC Traditional/Simplified, SimHash near-dedup); **Meilisearch** indexes documents; **Redis** caches hot queries; a **Telegram Bot** exposes `/search`, `/suggest`, `/stats`.

Python package name: `telegram-search-engine`. Repository folder/remote: `tg-search-engine`.

## Positioning

- Chinese: 自托管 Telegram 频道采集与中文友好全文搜索。
- English: Self-hosted Telegram message search with Chinese NLP pipeline.
- Stack: Python 3.11+, Telethon, Meilisearch, Redis, jieba, pypinyin, OpenCC, SimHash, python-telegram-bot, pydantic-settings.
- Crawler entry: `python -m apps.crawler.main`
- Bot entry: `python -m apps.bot.main`
- Config: `configs/app.toml` + env overrides (see `.env.example`)
- Repository: https://github.com/tytsxai/tg-search-engine
- License: MIT

## What it can do

- Add channels via `python -m apps.crawler.channels add ...`
- Crawl modes: `historical`, `realtime`, `both`
- Full-text search through Meilisearch index (default name `telegram_messages`)
- Chinese tokenization / pinyin / trad-simp conversion in pipeline
- SimHash near-duplicate filtering
- Redis cache TTL for search
- Production compose overlay: `docker-compose.prod.yml`

## What it does NOT do

- Not a public SaaS search of all Telegram
- Does not bypass Telegram access control
- Latency depends on deploy size — no guaranteed SLA
- First Telethon session often needs interactive phone login

## Quick start

```bash
git clone https://github.com/tytsxai/tg-search-engine.git
cd tg-search-engine
docker compose up -d
cp .env.example .env
python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e ".[dev]"
python -m apps.crawler.channels add -100... --username ... --title ...
python -m apps.crawler.main --mode both --limit 1000
python -m apps.bot.main
```
